{"rules": ["Model exhibits severe upward bias when recent history shows a sharp spike (e.g., >98) followed by immediate reversal; forecasts consistently overestimate the crash depth.", "Forecasts fail to capture mean reversion speed, predicting slow linear declines while actual outcomes drop rapidly within 5-7 days.", "Sentiment history of zero provides no corrective signal; model ignores lack of market confidence despite extreme price volatility.", "Model suffers from horizon-specific lag: it predicts a floor near the recent high (90-92) instead of recognizing the new low (65-70) as the immediate target.", "When history shows a peak >98, apply a negative correction factor of -15 to -20 EUR immediately in the forecast sequence.", "Reduce forecasted volatility by 40% and shift the entire curve downward by ~25 EUR when the last 3 days show a trend reversal from up to down."]
